newsitem.title: CANADA: CFCF okays early redemption of debentures.
newsitem.headline: CFCF okays early redemption of debentures.

text.p: Le Groupe Videotron Ltd and CFCF Inc said late on Wednesday that the board of directors of CFCF approved the early redemption of its convertible subordinated debentures issued on May 18, 1994, subject to the approval of debentureholders.

Videotron and CFCF also said that CFCF and the subsidiary of Videotron which acquired in June 1996, through a take-over bid, all of the multiple voting shares and 99.75 percent of the outstanding subordinated voting shares of CFCF, approved an deal whereby CFCF and the Videotron unit propose to amalgamate on April 1, 1997, subject to shareholder approval.

Videotron and CFCF said the approval by the debentureholders of the early redemption of all of the outstanding debentures will dispose of the uncertainty and of the legal proceedings resulting from the motion of certain debentureholders as to their entitlement to vote on the amalgamation to the regulatory authorities and will enable CFCF to seek approval of its shareholders alone before proceeding with the amalgamation.
The amalgamation will also render possible the privatization of CFCF.
